natalie: Quick postmortem follow-up — need owners for quota, scheduler tuning, headroom calc, and recurring-pattern alerts. Short timelines please.

omar: I'll take quota escalation. Filing today and adding production justification. ETA 3-5 business days. If delays >72h, enable fallback reserve pool.

reza: I'll own scheduler changes. Plan: canary with reduced packing window and added short-job lane. PR by 2026-04-02. Rollout conditional on smoke metrics.

abby: I'll do headroom modelling and cost impact. Draft 2026-04-03. Recommendation likely +10 GPUs and 3m smoothing.

ops-bot: deploy: autoscaler-policy v2 applied to prod-canary (sha: d4e5f6).

natalie: Also adding an alert: pager when free_gpus < 5 for 15m AND pod_eviction_rate > 3 in 10m. Owner: reza to add to runbook.

omar: Ticket T-6228 created: https://tickets.example.com/T-6228 (quota escalation).

reza: PR opened: https://git.example.com/redwood/scheduler/pulls/359 (canary cluster). Smoke OK so far.

abby: Headroom doc: https://docs.example.com/headroom/gpu-v3 draft uploaded.

natalie: Thanks — drop one-line updates here when tasks move. Next sync: 2026-04-04.
